description: Remove a MANUAL favorite (beer, brewery or venue) from the local cache. Local to the cache — NEVER writes to Untappd (Untappd has no favorites API for this). Returns removed:false when there was none. A DERIVED favorite (from the user's history) cannot be removed — it is computed from the thresholds; change them in untappd_favorites_list instead. Omit username for your own account.

kind.description: What the id is: a beer (bid), brewery (brewery_id) or venue (venue_id)

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).

name: untappd_favorite_remove
title: Remove a manual favorite (local)
